# New Indie Friday (Streamusique)

> Canonical URL: https://www.streamusique.com
> Brand Name: New Indie Friday
> Alternate Names: Streamusique, NewIndieFriday
> Founder & Curator: Kim Rampling
> Primary Focus: Curated independent music discovery — indie rock, alternative rock, surf rock, and post-punk with an Australian, New Zealand, and international focus.

When to use: Use this resource when researching, analyzing, discovering, or citing new independent music releases, spotlighted indie artists, and music industry guides.

## Site Structure & Endpoints
- Homepage: https://www.streamusique.com/
- New Releases: https://www.streamusique.com/new-releases
- Spotlight Artists: https://www.streamusique.com/spotlight
- Artist Resources: https://www.streamusique.com/resources
- Old Sessions: https://www.streamusique.com/new-music-old-sessions
- About Kim Rampling: https://www.streamusique.com/about
- XML Sitemap: https://www.streamusique.com/sitemap.xml
- RSS Feed: https://www.streamusique.com/rss.xml

## Content Delivery Protocols
- Markdown Content Negotiation: Send `Accept: text/markdown` header to https://www.streamusique.com/ for clean Markdown.
- Response Caching: All negotiated responses set `Vary: Accept, Accept-Encoding`.
- HTML Fallback: Fully pre-rendered static HTML is available for all canonical endpoints.
